status: Unselected whole-field development comparison. Bespoke threshold rail withdrawn as preferred detail; concrete performance/junction proof takes priority. No geometry, material, air, moisture, thermal or structural admission.

stockPriceScreen.scope: Advertised stock-only price, not a quotation, landed UK price, stock reservation, constituent acceptance or installed assembly cost. One full sheet per occupied layout slot is an explicit no-offcut-reuse scenario; returns are not silently nested into waste. No purchase.

panelLayout.rule: One explicit layout, not an optimised stock order. Clip the actual room-field topology; count connected pieces and shared seams, including three confirmed source-proposed RC crossings. Welding, backing, movement, protection and inspection remain unqualified.

mineralWallBase.status: Bonded DPC1 comparison only; exact unit, beds, constituents, mechanical and moisture performance remain unselected
mineralWallBase.rule: Two courses plus two beds occupy the existing 150 mm territory; a top bed belongs to the wall above. Full-width 215 mm headers are a proposed local base widening, not 102/102.5 mm stretchers silently supporting 140 mm walls. No cut unit or generic mortar acceptance.

thresholdCover.status: WITHDRAWN as preferred detail: integral pan retained, but fixed cover and grooved riser rail require custom seal/ends, thin lands and individually closed bolt penetrations without demonstrated whole-house benefit. Geometric trial only.
thresholdCover.rule: Fixed field rises behind the existing apron start and covers its dry horizontal leg with a nominal sliding gap. Its welded grooved riser rail closes against the existing 15 mm pan riser; groove depth is not an open flange gap. Remove the bolts and release end captures before north withdrawal; the fixed rail stays south of the receding riser and above the sliding zero-level apron. No permanent weld to the pan or wet-floor penetration.

metalSealBurden.role: Circular catalogue data used only to expose clamp and machining burden; rejected as a drop-in 1.78 m custom threshold seal
metalSealBurden.type: Wills Rings C, thin-wall K, 1.59 mm free height
metalSealBurden.scope: Typical circular data, not design criteria or evidence for a custom straight/end-return shape, formed-pan finish, working gap, force, water, air or renewal performance. Replace after dismantling; no polymer exception.

concreteControl.status: Conditional complete-route challenger, not a universal membrane waiver
concreteControl.sourceRole: England AD C 2004 edition with 2010/2013 amendments, paragraphs 4.17–4.22 and 5.5; accessed 6 November 2026. Guidance control, not project acceptance or proof of connected support, floor-joint, air or gas performance.
requires: Actual monolithic concrete/crack/construction-joint air and moisture performance under the assigned exposures
Continuous external and internal wall/pier DPC, floor/wall and three actual threshold transitions
Actual wet-tolerant subfloor and outdoor contacts, gravity routes, vapour/drying and condensation consequences
Site-specific ground-gas and pressure-water suitability without relying on active dewatering
Complete constituents, intervention route and actual thermal/heat price
